focus: 沿製造浮運到基床受力追蹤沉箱防波堤的狀態變化~Track caisson-breakwater state changes from fabrication and flotation to foundation loading

units.anchor: 混凝土量與重量~Concrete volume and weight
units.title: 混凝土量與重量~Concrete volume and weight
units.mechanism: 沉箱的外包體積、混凝土材料體積與填艙材料量是不同量，浮運和落床分析不能交換使用。重量需要逐項配平，鋼筋、臨時設備和殘留水亦會改變重心；只看外部尺寸並不能得出可靠排水量。 假設混凝土密度2400kg/m³、材料體積1000m³，質量2400000kg，重量mg=23544kN；這不是浮力所用外包體積。 水下材料重量與浮運排水重量屬不同控制體，列式時必須保持同一受力邊界。~Envelope volume, concrete volume and ballast quantity are different quantities and cannot be exchanged between floating and seated conditions. Weight accounting also includes reinforcement, temporary equipment and retained water, all of which can shift the center of gravity despite unchanged outer dimensions. Assume concrete density2400kg/m³ and material volume1000m³. Mass is2400000kg and weight23544kN; this is not the envelope volume used for buoyancy. Submerged material weight and whole-body floating displacement use different control volumes, requiring a consistent force boundary when assembling equilibrium.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設混凝土密度2400kg/m³、材料體積1000m³，質量2400000kg，重量mg=23544kN；這不是浮力所用外包體積。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume concrete density2400kg/m³ and material volume1000m³. Mass is2400000kg and weight23544kN; this is not the envelope volume used for buoyancy.
units.verify: 依竣工尺寸與材料密度建立重量分項表，核對鋼筋、設備和艙水是否重複或遺漏。用吃水及已知海水密度作獨立平衡檢查，追查差異而非調整密度湊合。將重量表各分項回連到量測證據。~Build a weight schedule from actual geometry and densities, checking reinforcement, equipment and tank water for omission or duplication. Independently compare draft and water density, investigating discrepancies rather than tuning density to fit. Link each weight-schedule entry to its measurement evidence.
units.failure: 將中空艙室也算成混凝土會高估重量，漏計艙水則低估吃水；兩項誤差可能偶然抵銷總重量卻留下錯誤重心，使後續浮穩判斷仍然失真。~Counting hollow cells as concrete overstates weight while omitting tank water understates draft. These errors may accidentally cancel total mass yet leave the center of gravity wrong, corrupting subsequent stability interpretation.
units.misconception: 沉箱外包體積乘混凝土密度就等於實際總重量。~Caisson envelope volume times concrete density equals its actual total mass.
units.practice: 依竣工尺寸與材料密度建立重量分項表，核對鋼筋、設備和艙水是否重複或遺漏。用吃水及已知海水密度作獨立平衡檢查，追查差異而非調整密度湊合。~Build a weight schedule from actual geometry and densities, checking reinforcement, equipment and tank water for omission or duplication. Independently compare draft and water density, investigating discrepancies rather than tuning density to fit.

units.anchor: 靜態吃水平衡~Static draft equilibrium
units.title: 靜態吃水平衡~Static draft equilibrium
units.mechanism: 完整密閉浮體在靜水中以排開水的重量平衡自重，矩形水線面才可用常面積直接換算吃水。艙口進水、外形變化和水面傾斜會改變條件，因此初步計算不能取代實際浮運狀態的檢查。 假設總質量2460000kg、海水1025kg/m³、水線面400m²，吃水T=m/(ρA)=6m；側高10m時靜態乾舷4m。 乾舷還須按可能先進水的開口高程判斷，外牆最高點不是唯一相關高度。~A sealed body at rest balances its weight with displaced water, and a constant rectangular waterplane permits direct draft conversion. Flooding, changing exterior geometry and heel alter the assumptions, so this initial calculation cannot replace verification of the actual floating condition. Assume mass2460000kg, seawater1025kg/m³ and waterplane400m². Draft T=m/(ρA)=6m; a10m side gives static freeboard4m. Freeboard also depends on openings that can admit water first; the highest exterior wall point is not the only relevant elevation.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設總質量2460000kg、海水1025kg/m³、水線面400m²，吃水T=m/(ρA)=6m；側高10m時靜態乾舷4m。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume mass2460000kg, seawater1025kg/m³ and waterplane400m². Draft T=m/(ρA)=6m; a10m side gives static freeboard4m.
units.verify: 在多個角點讀取吃水，換算共同水位並檢查傾斜，將實測排水量和重量表核對。另列波浪、拖航和艙口條件，避免把靜水乾舷當成任何海況的操作裕度。另記最低非密閉開口的高程。~Read draft at several corners, reference a common level and check heel against the weight schedule. Separately document waves, towing and openings rather than treating calm-water freeboard as a margin for every sea state. Record the lowest unsealed opening elevation independently.
units.failure: 艙內漏水會使吃水增加並可能降低乾舷，僅讀取一側吃水又會漏掉傾斜。靜態平均值看似符合計算時，另一角仍可能先進水並改變整個浮力邊界。~Internal flooding increases draft and may reduce freeboard, while one-sided readings miss heel. Even a matching mean draft can conceal an exposed corner that floods first and changes the complete buoyancy boundary.
units.misconception: 平均吃水吻合就可忽略四角差異與艙口進水可能。~Matching mean draft makes corner differences and flooding through openings irrelevant.
units.practice: 在多個角點讀取吃水，換算共同水位並檢查傾斜，將實測排水量和重量表核對。另列波浪、拖航和艙口條件，避免把靜水乾舷當成任何海況的操作裕度。~Read draft at several corners, reference a common level and check heel against the weight schedule. Separately document waves, towing and openings rather than treating calm-water freeboard as a margin for every sea state.

units.anchor: 初穩性幾何尺度~Initial stability geometry
units.title: 初穩性幾何尺度~Initial stability geometry
units.mechanism: 小角度浮穩分析以浮心、重心和水線面慣性矩建立初穩心高度，與大角度復原力臂並不相同。水線形狀和轉動軸必須明示，不能用一個正值保證拖航中所有波浪、風力及進水情境都穩定。 假設20m×20m矩形水線、吃水6m、排水V=2400m³、KB=3m、KG=7m，GM=3+(20×20³/12)/2400−7=1.556m。 初穩性公式的排水體積必須對應當下吃水，改變配重後不能只更新重心。~Small-angle stability uses buoyancy center, gravity center and waterplane second moment to obtain metacentric height, not the full large-angle righting arm. Define the waterplane and rotation axis explicitly; a positive value cannot qualify every towing, wind, wave or flooding case. Assume20m×20m waterplane,6m draft, displacement2400m³, KB=3m and KG=7m. GM=3+(20×20³/12)/2400−7=1.556m. The displacement volume in initial stability must match current draft; after ballasting, updating gravity center alone is not sufficient.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設20m×20m矩形水線、吃水6m、排水V=2400m³、KB=3m、KG=7m，GM=3+(20×20³/12)/2400−7=1.556m。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume20m×20m waterplane,6m draft, displacement2400m³, KB=3m and KG=7m. GM=3+(20×20³/12)/2400−7=1.556m.
units.verify: 在圖上標出轉動軸和慣性矩計算方向，逐項核對重心與浮心的高程基準。再檢查艙內自由液面及可能進水位置，把小角線性結果與完整浮穩需求分開。再以排水質量驗算當下浮力平衡。~Draw the rotation axis and second-moment direction and verify common datums for gravity and buoyancy centers. Check internal free surfaces and flooding openings separately, distinguishing the small-angle result from complete stability requirements. Recheck current buoyancy against the displacement mass.
units.failure: 軸向用錯會把長寬差異轉成巨大剛度誤差，重心漏算又會高估復原能力。正初穩心高度不能排除大角度失穩，也不能抵銷自由液面與波浪耦合的不利影響。~Using the wrong axis transforms length-width differences into a major stiffness error, while omitted weights overstate righting ability. Positive initial height does not exclude large-angle instability or adverse free-surface and wave coupling.
units.misconception: 初穩心高度大於零就代表任何傾角與拖航海況都安全。~Positive metacentric height guarantees safety at every heel angle and towing condition.
units.practice: 在圖上標出轉動軸和慣性矩計算方向，逐項核對重心與浮心的高程基準。再檢查艙內自由液面及可能進水位置，把小角線性結果與完整浮穩需求分開。~Draw the rotation axis and second-moment direction and verify common datums for gravity and buoyancy centers. Check internal free surfaces and flooding openings separately, distinguishing the small-angle result from complete stability requirements.

units.anchor: 艙內自由液面~Internal free-surface effect
units.title: 艙內自由液面~Internal free-surface effect
units.mechanism: 部分裝滿的艙液會隨浮體傾斜移動，等效降低初穩性；全空或全滿的情況不能套同一自由液面修正。液面慣性矩與連通範圍比液體總量更重要，因此分艙完整性是浮穩模型的一部分。 假設同密度艙水的自由液面10m×10m、排水2400m³，修正ΔGM=If/V=(10×10³/12)/2400=0.3472m；只適用小角近似。 修正也取決於艙液與外水的密度比，不同液體時不能直接省略該係數。~Liquid in a partially filled tank shifts with heel and reduces initial stability. Empty and pressed-full tanks do not share this correction. Surface second moment and connected extent matter more than liquid quantity alone, making compartment integrity part of the stability model. Assume same-density tank water, a10m×10m free surface and2400m³ displacement. ΔGM=If/V=0.3472m under the small-angle approximation. The correction also depends on the density ratio between tank liquid and surrounding water, which cannot be omitted for different liquids.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同密度艙水的自由液面10m×10m、排水2400m³，修正ΔGM=If/V=(10×10³/12)/2400=0.3472m；只適用小角近似。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume same-density tank water, a10m×10m free surface and2400m³ displacement. ΔGM=If/V=0.3472m under the small-angle approximation.
units.verify: 逐艙畫出液位與可能連通路徑，核對修正所用液體密度和自由面尺寸。比較隔艙完整與連通的模型，並保存任何配置變更的浮穩再評估紀錄。明列艙水與外水的密度比。~Map levels and possible connections in each cell, verifying fluid density and surface dimensions in the correction. Compare isolated and connected compartments and retain the stability reassessment for every configuration change. State the tank-liquid to surrounding-water density ratio explicitly.
units.failure: 隔板開孔造成原先獨立液面連通時，慣性矩可大幅增加；只看總艙水量不變會漏掉穩性下降。液位誤判為全滿也可能完全省略實際存在的自由液面。~Openings that connect previously separate tanks can greatly increase surface second moment. Unchanged total water volume conceals lost stability, and incorrectly declaring a tank full can omit an existing free surface entirely.
units.misconception: 艙水總量不變時自由液面對浮穩的影響也不會改變。~An unchanged quantity of tank water means an unchanged free-surface effect.
units.practice: 逐艙畫出液位與可能連通路徑，核對修正所用液體密度和自由面尺寸。比較隔艙完整與連通的模型，並保存任何配置變更的浮穩再評估紀錄。~Map levels and possible connections in each cell, verifying fluid density and surface dimensions in the correction. Compare isolated and connected compartments and retain the stability reassessment for every configuration change.

units.anchor: 配重與吃水增量~Ballast and draft increment
units.title: 配重與吃水增量~Ballast and draft increment
units.mechanism: 增加配重會增加排水量，但各艙位置也決定傾斜和結構內力。常水線面換算只能估平均吃水增量，不能推定所有角點同步下沉，也不能以這個靜力算式指揮實際沉放程序。 假設增重205000kg、海水1025kg/m³、水線面400m²，ΔT=Δm/(ρA)=0.50m；水線面與密閉狀態保持不變。 吃水增量與波浪造成的瞬時角點運動不同，量測比較應採對應的時間平均。~Added ballast increases displacement while its location changes heel and internal actions. A constant-waterplane conversion estimates mean draft increment only; it does not imply equal movement at every corner or authorize an actual lowering sequence from this static calculation. Assume added205000kg, seawater1025kg/m³ and waterplane400m². ΔT=Δm/(ρA)=0.50m at unchanged geometry and sealed condition. Draft increment differs from instantaneous corner motion caused by waves, so measurement comparisons require a matching averaging period and definition.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設增重205000kg、海水1025kg/m³、水線面400m²，ΔT=Δm/(ρA)=0.50m；水線面與密閉狀態保持不變。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume added205000kg, seawater1025kg/m³ and waterplane400m². ΔT=Δm/(ρA)=0.50m at unchanged geometry and sealed condition.
units.verify: 將配重位置和總重量分開列示，核對四角吃水增量及艙內實際液位。以受核准的施工控制紀錄比較預測與量測，不用平均吃水掩蓋局部傾斜或設備故障。檢查吃水量測的時間平均窗口。~Record ballast positions separately from total weight and compare corner draft changes with actual cell levels. Use the approved construction-control record to investigate disagreement without hiding heel or equipment faults behind mean draft. Check the averaging window used for draft observations.
units.failure: 一側閥件或量測失效可能使平均增重正確但傾斜快速擴大，艙內自由液面也可能同時改變；若只依總重量完成指標，便會漏掉真正控制過渡狀態的介面。~A one-sided valve or measurement fault can produce the correct total added mass while heel grows. Free-surface effects may change simultaneously, so total-weight completion alone misses the interface governing the transition.
units.misconception: 計算出平均吃水增量後就能直接指定現場配重操作順序。~A calculated mean draft increment directly determines the field ballasting sequence.
units.practice: 將配重位置和總重量分開列示，核對四角吃水增量及艙內實際液位。以受核准的施工控制紀錄比較預測與量測，不用平均吃水掩蓋局部傾斜或設備故障。~Record ballast positions separately from total weight and compare corner draft changes with actual cell levels. Use the approved construction-control record to investigate disagreement without hiding heel or equipment faults behind mean draft.

units.title: 底面揚壓積分~Base-uplift integration
units.mechanism: 落床沉箱底面水壓減少有效壓力接觸，分布取決於滲流、排水與波浪傳遞。兩端線性插值是一個假設，不是所有基床都會呈現的真實形狀；合力與作用點都會影響滑動和偏心。 假設每米堤長、底寬20m，底壓由80線性降至20kPa，U=(80+20)×20/2=1000kN/m；未計時變壓力。 底壓作用點還決定傾覆力矩，相同揚壓總量不代表相同底面接觸狀態。~Pressure beneath a seated caisson reduces effective contact and depends on seepage, drainage and wave transmission. Linear interpolation between edges is an assumption rather than a universal foundation pattern. Both resultant and location influence sliding and eccentric response. Assume unit breakwater length,20m base width and linear pressure from80 to20kPa. U=(80+20)×20/2=1000kN/m, excluding time variation. The uplift application point also determines moment, so equal total uplift does not imply an identical foundation contact-pressure distribution.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設每米堤長、底寬20m，底壓由80線性降至20kPa，U=(80+20)×20/2=1000kN/m；未計時變壓力。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume unit breakwater length,20m base width and linear pressure from80 to20kPa. U=(80+20)×20/2=1000kN/m, excluding time variation.
units.verify: 用同一時間的底面壓力重建分布，檢查端點之間是否有測點支持線性假設。將揚壓積分和接觸反力核對，另列波峰與波谷可能不同的傳壓相位。另外積分壓力對底面中心的力矩。~Reconstruct the distribution from simultaneous base pressures and check intermediate evidence for linearity. Compare integrated uplift with contact reaction, documenting different transmission phases at wave crests and troughs rather than mixing them. Integrate the pressure moment about the base center separately.
units.failure: 底面中部高壓可能被端點量測漏掉，排水堵塞也會改變分布。把不同時刻的壓力峰值任意拼在一起，則可能製造不存在的合力與偏心，兩種錯誤方向都需查核。~An internal pressure high can escape edge measurements, and blocked drainage changes the distribution. Combining unrelated peak times can instead create a nonexistent force and eccentricity; both error directions require investigation.
units.misconception: 底面揚壓永遠是海側與港側水壓的線性連線。~Base uplift always follows a straight line between sea-side and harbor-side pressure.
units.practice: 用同一時間的底面壓力重建分布，檢查端點之間是否有測點支持線性假設。將揚壓積分和接觸反力核對，另列波峰與波谷可能不同的傳壓相位。~Reconstruct the distribution from simultaneous base pressures and check intermediate evidence for linearity. Compare integrated uplift with contact reaction, documenting different transmission phases at wave crests and troughs rather than mixing them.

units.anchor: 滑動平衡的界限~Limits of sliding equilibrium
units.title: 滑動平衡的界限~Limits of sliding equilibrium
units.mechanism: 簡化摩擦抵抗以有效法向力為基礎，底面揚壓不能忽略。摩擦係數受材料和接觸狀態影響，動態荷載、搖擺與地基破壞則另有機制；一個比值不能涵蓋所有施工與使用狀態。 假設每米W=4000kN、U=1000kN、μ=0.6、H=1500kN，R=μ(W−U)=1800kN，R/H=1.20；非規範安全係數。 水平與垂直動載若不同相位，摩擦餘裕的最小時刻不一定是最大水平力時刻。~A friction estimate depends on effective normal force, including uplift reduction. Interface material and condition govern the coefficient, while dynamic loading, rocking and foundation failure involve additional mechanisms. One equilibrium ratio does not cover every construction and operational state. Assume per-metre W=4000kN, U=1000kN, μ=0.6 and H=1500kN. R=1800kN and R/H=1.20, not a code safety factor. With phase differences between horizontal and vertical dynamics, the minimum friction margin need not occur at the peak horizontal force.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設每米W=4000kN、U=1000kN、μ=0.6、H=1500kN，R=μ(W−U)=1800kN，R/H=1.20；非規範安全係數。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume per-metre W=4000kN, U=1000kN, μ=0.6 and H=1500kN. R=1800kN and R/H=1.20, not a code safety factor.
units.verify: 核對重量、揚壓和水平力是否來自同一受力情境，說明摩擦係數的試驗依據。再分別列出地基、傾覆及接觸不完整的檢查，避免用一個比例替代多種失效。檢查同時刻的水平力與底面揚壓。~Check that weight, uplift and horizontal force belong to one loading case and document interface testing for friction. Separately assess foundation behavior, overturning and incomplete contact instead of substituting one ratio for multiple mechanisms. Check horizontal load and uplift at matching times.
units.failure: 揚壓上升會在外觀重量不變時降低接觸反力，底面細料流失也可能改變摩擦條件；若沿用初期乾接觸係數，計算上的餘裕會比實際系統更樂觀。~Rising uplift reduces contact while visible weight remains unchanged, and loss of fines changes the interface. Retaining an initial dry-contact coefficient can therefore overstate the margin of the actual submerged foundation system.
units.misconception: 沉箱自重很大就可以忽略揚壓對滑動抵抗的影響。~A very heavy caisson makes uplift irrelevant to sliding resistance.
units.practice: 核對重量、揚壓和水平力是否來自同一受力情境，說明摩擦係數的試驗依據。再分別列出地基、傾覆及接觸不完整的檢查，避免用一個比例替代多種失效。~Check that weight, uplift and horizontal force belong to one loading case and document interface testing for friction. Separately assess foundation behavior, overturning and incomplete contact instead of substituting one ratio for multiple mechanisms.

units.anchor: 偏心與全接觸~Eccentricity and full contact
units.title: 偏心與全接觸~Eccentricity and full contact
units.mechanism: 垂直合力的偏心會改變底面壓力，矩形底面在線彈性全接觸假設下才有核心界線。邊緣計算壓力降為零表示接觸模型來到界限，超出後應改用不承拉接觸，而非讓地基承受虛構拉力。 假設每米N=2000kN、M=4000kN·m、B=12m，e=M/N=2m=B/6；qmax=333.3kPa、qmin=0，為全接觸邊界。 這個壓力圖只處理接觸分布，不包含基床材料強度或循環退化的判定。~Eccentric vertical force redistributes base pressure. The rectangular kern applies to a linear full-contact model; zero edge pressure marks its boundary. Beyond that point, use no-tension contact rather than allowing a foundation to resist fictitious tensile pressure. Assume per-metre N=2000kN, M=4000kN·m and B=12m. e=2m=B/6; qmax=333.3kPa and qmin=0 at the full-contact boundary. This pressure diagram addresses contact distribution only; it does not establish bedding-material strength or resistance to deterioration under cyclic loading.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設每米N=2000kN、M=4000kN·m、B=12m，e=M/N=2m=B/6；qmax=333.3kPa、qmin=0，為全接觸邊界。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume per-metre N=2000kN, M=4000kN·m and B=12m. e=2m=B/6; qmax=333.3kPa and qmin=0 at the full-contact boundary.
units.verify: 明示力矩參考點和正負方向，獨立積分壓力分布重建原法向力與力矩。檢查底床平整度、接觸缺口及土體承載，不能把幾何核心條件當成完整承載驗算。以壓力圖積分核對合力作用位置。~State the moment reference and signs, independently integrating pressure to recover force and moment. Check bedding flatness, gaps and ground resistance; the geometric kern condition is not a complete bearing-capacity assessment. Integrate the pressure diagram to verify the resultant location.
units.failure: 直接接受負接觸壓力會高估有效承壓面積，局部接觸其實可能集中在狹窄邊緣；平均壓力仍小時，局部地基破壞和沉箱轉動已可能開始。~Accepting negative contact pressure overstates effective bearing area when actual contact is concentrated near an edge. Local foundation failure and caisson rotation can begin even while the computed average pressure remains modest.
units.misconception: 偏心超出核心後仍可讓地基以負壓力維持全接觸。~Beyond the kern, negative foundation pressure can preserve full contact.
units.practice: 明示力矩參考點和正負方向，獨立積分壓力分布重建原法向力與力矩。檢查底床平整度、接觸缺口及土體承載，不能把幾何核心條件當成完整承載驗算。~State the moment reference and signs, independently integrating pressure to recover force and moment. Check bedding flatness, gaps and ground resistance; the geometric kern condition is not a complete bearing-capacity assessment.

units.anchor: 差異沉陷與轉角~Differential settlement and rotation
units.title: 差異沉陷與轉角~Differential settlement and rotation
units.mechanism: 相鄰或同一沉箱兩端的差異沉陷會改變接縫、堤頂和上部設施幾何，並不等同平均下沉。小轉角可由兩點高差估算，但沉箱彎曲或局部支承變形會破壞剛體近似，需要多點資料辨識。 假設兩端相距20m、沉陷差20mm，θ≈0.020/20=0.001rad=0.0573°；只作剛體小角示意。 多點資料還能辨識局部支承沉陷，兩端連線以外的殘差不應直接當量測噪音。~Differential movement changes joints, crest and upper facilities and is distinct from mean settlement. Two-point elevation difference estimates a small rigid-body rotation, but flexure or localized support deformation violates that approximation and requires additional observations to distinguish. Assume endpoints20m apart with20mm differential settlement. θ≈0.020/20=0.001rad=0.0573° is a small rigid-body illustration. Additional points can reveal localized support movement; residuals away from the endpoint line should not automatically be dismissed as measurement noise.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設兩端相距20m、沉陷差20mm，θ≈0.020/20=0.001rad=0.0573°；只作剛體小角示意。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume endpoints20m apart with20mm differential settlement. θ≈0.020/20=0.001rad=0.0573° is a small rigid-body illustration.
units.verify: 以共同穩定基準同步測量多個角點，分解平均沉陷、剛體轉動與局部殘差。把接縫張開與基床量測相互對照，保留無法由剛體模型解釋的變形供調查。檢查中間測點相對剛體線的殘差。~Observe several corners against one stable datum, separating mean settlement, rigid rotation and local residuals. Compare joint opening with foundation measurements and preserve deformation that the rigid-body model cannot explain for investigation. Check intermediate observations against the rigid-body line residuals.
units.failure: 基準點本身移動會讓整體沉陷被抵銷，僅看兩點又可能把彎曲誤認為旋轉。若忽略局部接觸變化，後續止水損壞與上部設備偏移便難以追溯原因。~Movement of the reference hides overall settlement, while two points can confuse flexure with rotation. Ignoring local contact changes then obscures the causes of later joint leakage or misalignment in the facilities above.
units.misconception: 兩點高差計算出的轉角可以完整代表沉箱所有變形。~Rotation calculated from two elevations fully describes every caisson deformation.
units.practice: 以共同穩定基準同步測量多個角點，分解平均沉陷、剛體轉動與局部殘差。把接縫張開與基床量測相互對照，保留無法由剛體模型解釋的變形供調查。~Observe several corners against one stable datum, separating mean settlement, rigid rotation and local residuals. Compare joint opening with foundation measurements and preserve deformation that the rigid-body model cannot explain for investigation.

units.anchor: 雙側水壓與越流~Two-sided pressure and overflow
units.title: 雙側水壓與越流~Two-sided pressure and overflow
units.mechanism: 靜水壓在兩側分別積分後才可相減，單一水位差乘整面積通常會漏掉壓力分布。越流海嘯可能伴隨背面負壓和基床沖刷，已超出靜水模型；不能將正常潮位算式當成極端事件荷載。 假設同底面起算兩側靜水深8與6m、海水γ=10.05525kN/m³，每米淨力F=γ(8²−6²)/2=140.7735kN；非海嘯力。 靜水三角形的作用點位於各水深底部以上三分之一，兩側力矩仍須分開計算。~Hydrostatic pressure is integrated separately on each side before subtraction; one head difference times the entire wall area generally misses the distribution. Tsunami overflow can include rear suction and foundation scour beyond hydrostatics, so ordinary tide calculations cannot establish extreme-event loading. Assume still depths8m and6m from one base and seawater γ=10.05525kN/m³. Net force per metre isγ(8²−6²)/2=140.7735kN, not tsunami force. Each hydrostatic triangle acts one-third of its depth above the base, requiring separate moment calculation before subtracting the two sides.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同底面起算兩側靜水深8與6m、海水γ=10.05525kN/m³，每米淨力F=γ(8²−6²)/2=140.7735kN；非海嘯力。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume still depths8m and6m from one base and seawater γ=10.05525kN/m³. Net force per metre isγ(8²−6²)/2=140.7735kN, not tsunami force.
units.verify: 畫出兩側三角壓力圖和各自作用點，再核對有無越流、流速及底床演變。與水工試驗和事件記錄比對，明列哪些附加作用沒有包含在靜水差值中。分別計算兩側水壓對底部的力矩。~Draw both triangular pressure distributions and their application points, then check overflow, velocity and bed evolution. Compare hydraulic tests or event records and explicitly list additional actions omitted from the static pressure difference. Calculate each side's pressure moment about the base separately.
units.failure: 越流背面吸力會在水位差相同時增加水平作用，沖刷又會削弱支承；只放大靜水力而不更新接觸與底床，可能錯過真正導致沉箱移動的組合機制。~Rear suction increases horizontal action at unchanged head difference, while scour weakens support. Multiplying static force without updating contact and bedding can miss the coupled mechanism that actually initiates caisson displacement.
units.misconception: 已知兩側水位差就足以算出任何海嘯越流時的總荷載。~Knowing the two water levels is sufficient for total loading under any tsunami overflow.
units.practice: 畫出兩側三角壓力圖和各自作用點，再核對有無越流、流速及底床演變。與水工試驗和事件記錄比對，明列哪些附加作用沒有包含在靜水差值中。~Draw both triangular pressure distributions and their application points, then check overflow, velocity and bed evolution. Compare hydraulic tests or event records and explicitly list additional actions omitted from the static pressure difference.

title: 沉箱式防波堤施工~Caisson breakwater construction
summary: 沿製造浮運到基床受力追蹤沉箱防波堤的狀態變化。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。~Track caisson-breakwater state changes from fabrication and flotation to foundation loading. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
history: 沉箱方法的教學重點是狀態轉換，不用單一建成年份代替全部知識歷史。日本港灣空港研究所於二〇一二年公布釜石防波堤研究，針對二〇一一年海嘯事件指出越流與背面負壓等機制。新加坡主管機關記錄二〇一六年大士港首座沉箱，以及二〇一九年第一期最後沉箱的安裝；這是碼頭建造比較，並非同一海嘯受力案例。香港及美國官方指南提供一般工程框架，仍須配合實際地盤、波況和施工階段。課程數值全為原創假設，不冒充兩地原設計圖或現場性能。~The teaching emphasis is the transition between caisson states rather than one construction year standing for the entire history. PARI published its Kamaishi investigation in2012 after the2011 tsunami, addressing overflow and rear-side pressure mechanisms. Singapore records the first Tuas caisson installation in2016 and the final Phase1 installation in2019. That quay project provides a construction comparison, not an identical tsunami load case. Hong Kong and US official guidance supply a general engineering framework requiring actual ground, waves and staging. Every numerical example is original and synthetic, not an original design drawing or measured performance from either location.
example: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設混凝土密度2400kg/m³、材料體積1000m³，質量2400000kg，重量mg=23544kN；這不是浮力所用外包體積。假設混凝土材料體積由1000增10%至1100m³、密度固定2400kg/m³，重量由23544增至25898.4kN；浮體的排水體積和重心必須另行更新，不能宣稱浮穩同步改善10%。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。~This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume concrete density2400kg/m³ and material volume1000m³. Mass is2400000kg and weight23544kN; this is not the envelope volume used for buoyancy. Increasing concrete volume from1000 to1100m³ by10% at fixed2400kg/m³ changes weight from23544 to25898.4kN. Displacement and gravity center require separate updates; stability does not automatically improve by10%. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
facts: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設混凝土密度2400kg/m³、材料體積1000m³，質量2400000kg，重量mg=23544kN；這不是浮力所用外包體積。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume concrete density2400kg/m³ and material volume1000m³. Mass is2400000kg and weight23544kN; this is not the envelope volume used for buoyancy.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設總質量2460000kg、海水1025kg/m³、水線面400m²，吃水T=m/(ρA)=6m；側高10m時靜態乾舷4m。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume mass2460000kg, seawater1025kg/m³ and waterplane400m². Draft T=m/(ρA)=6m; a10m side gives static freeboard4m.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設20m×20m矩形水線、吃水6m、排水V=2400m³、KB=3m、KG=7m，GM=3+(20×20³/12)/2400−7=1.556m。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume20m×20m waterplane,6m draft, displacement2400m³, KB=3m and KG=7m. GM=3+(20×20³/12)/2400−7=1.556m.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同密度艙水的自由液面10m×10m、排水2400m³，修正ΔGM=If/V=(10×10³/12)/2400=0.3472m；只適用小角近似。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume same-density tank water, a10m×10m free surface and2400m³ displacement. ΔGM=If/V=0.3472m under the small-angle approximation.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設增重205000kg、海水1025kg/m³、水線面400m²，ΔT=Δm/(ρA)=0.50m；水線面與密閉狀態保持不變。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume added205000kg, seawater1025kg/m³ and waterplane400m². ΔT=Δm/(ρA)=0.50m at unchanged geometry and sealed condition.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設每米堤長、底寬20m，底壓由80線性降至20kPa，U=(80+20)×20/2=1000kN/m；未計時變壓力。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume unit breakwater length,20m base width and linear pressure from80 to20kPa. U=(80+20)×20/2=1000kN/m, excluding time variation.
